_about: Where each notebook's files are staged on Rakiura. Ticks (nt.portal.done) need no ids: a PI links each part name to a checklist item under Settings > Notebook links, keyed by the notebook path. Staging the verdict file needs a step id: fill in 'step' (for example "ONB-102-D7") once the step exists, or set RAKIURA_STEP for one session. Leave null to have members attach files on the step page.

parts.dipeptide-verdict: verdict and replication rows handed in

parts.amino-acid-verdict: backbone signal and verdict handed in

parts.raw-overlay: own processing over the instrument's (figure, line differences, similarity, decision)
